_readme: Oxygen Students Paradise, Thriprayar — the main counter PC. Copy to the repo root as store_config.json (gitignored) and restart the watcher. See config/stores/README.md.
_readme_printer_queue_names: The Konica driver ignores SumatraPDF's per-job duplex/simplex override in both directions, so print_server picks the QUEUE instead (print_server._konica_queue_for_sides). OSP runs a second Windows queue defaulted to 2-sided for duplex, and keeps the original queue — defaulted to 1-sided — as the simplex one. Said out loud rather than left to fall through: an unset konica_simplex routes to the same queue, but reads as 'nobody configured this'. What makes it work is each queue's persisted Printing Preferences default, not this file. See install/INSTALL.md.
